# SOCIS Brand Assets

Logo assets used across the `socisio` GitHub organization (profile README, repo READMEs, social previews).

| File | Usage |
|---|---|
| `socis_logo.png` | Primary SOCIS company logo |
| `socis_enterprise_logo.png` | SOCIS Enterprise banner — icon, wordmark & tagline (Unified Detection, Investigation & Response) |
| `socis_trace_logo.png` | SOCIS Trace banner — icon, wordmark & tagline (Self-Hosted OSINT Investigation Workbench) |
| `socis_sentinel_ai_logo.png` | SOCIS Sentinel AI banner — icon, wordmark & tagline (Autonomous AI Agent Platform for Cyber Defense) |
| `socis_hexcage_logo.png` | SOCIS HexCage banner — icon, wordmark & tagline (Malware Sandbox & Payload Extraction) |

Source assets are maintained in the main [socis-website](https://github.com/socisio/socis-website) repository under `assets/images/` and `assets/images/product-logos/`. When product branding changes, update the source there first, then re-export/copy the current version into this folder so the org profile stays in sync.
